comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. Each blip's frequency is (1000 + knob*4000) * 2^V, clamped to 1000..5000Hz, so the pitch jack can only push the blips up as far as the ceiling. A fifth parameter exists in the module but has no widget on the panel, so no click can reach it and it gets no line. The pitch jack is clamped to 0 to 5V before the exponential, so negative voltages do nothing.
